name: cold14-st2u4
title: st2 with CarrierBypass's four premix-only dim-8 jp8 cold ends (u4), at dispatch jp8 x71, ck x1 with an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP warm-started from st2's map)
summary: Provider menu {ck, jp8}: st2 words; the jp8 cold_end recipe is CarrierBypass st_u4/cold_end_recipe.json.gz (st2's recipe plus 16 rank-0 premix gates, 40 frame-[] target writes, the new lower-frame tail and a recomputed Gauss-Jordan remainder; 4 new cold ends at U*). Owner search with Stack492's solve_h.py (helper ranges from the word R; objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001635) on the st2u4 provider locals (ColdThird runs/D6, patched controls): (1) aggregate free-dispatch LP over {ck, jp8} (crossover, tight 3) warm-started from st2's map -> LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json, which selects jp8 at every time; (2) dispatch: ck pinned at time 5 (the global controls need two dispatched providers) -> DISPATCH.json (jp8 x71, ck x1); (3) exact-window MIP at that dispatch over base + AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01, warm-started from st2's map, gap 1e-9, 2 threads, 600 s, without RINS (RINS bounds made the warm start infeasible and gave no incumbent in 240 s): time limit, obj 523257.529140, bound 523257.491609, gap 7.17e-8; (4) mkplan.py --locals (st2u4 locals) reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte. The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the dispatch jp8 ×71, ck ×1 (the aggregate free-dispatch LP selects jp8 at every time; ck is pinned at time 5 because the global controls need two dispatched providers)
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals (widths over the word's R helpers) and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (Stack492 mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution (600 s time limit, relative gap 7.17e-8), warm-started from complex-571-cold14-st2's map
owners.warm_owners_origin: complex-571-cold14-st2's `data/OWNERS.json.gz` (byte for byte), the warm start of the aggregate LP and the MIP

search.tool: solve_h.py (Stack492's copy: helper ranges from the word R)
search.dispatch_rule: per-time argmax of LP-PATTERNS-AGG selections (jp8 everywhere), then ck pinned at time 5

mip.note: no RINS: the RINS bounds made the warm start infeasible and gave no incumbent in 240 s

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over the st2u4 words {ck, jp8} (crossover, tight 3), warm-started from st2's map
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider}: jp8 everywhere except ck at time 5
lp_inputs.WARM-PLAN.json: the window MIP's PLAN for st2's map (before mkplan; same dispatch), matching WARM-OWNERS.json.gz
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: the PLAN whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses (same as PR622's)

commands.mip: solve_h.py --template-plan TEMPLATE-PLAN.json --b 0.001635 --threads 2 --provider ck=<locs3>/ck-local --provider jp8=<locs3>/jp8-local --dispatch DISPATCH.json --pattern-file LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json --pmin 0.01 --warm-owners WARM-OWNERS.json.gz --warm-plan WARM-PLAN.json --exact-windows --seconds 600 --gap 1e-9
